subject: Next steps: Demo window & documentation handoff for EdgeGrid pilot

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Dunn <a.dunn@edgegrid.io>
Cc: EdgeGrid Security <security@edgegrid.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — next steps & demo options

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and useful context on your latency constraints and multi-tenant data requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference for EdgeGrid's customer-facing assistants (p50 < 200ms).
- Data sensitivity: customer PII will be redacted at the app layer; EdgeGrid needs audit logs + KMS integration.
- Success criteria for pilot: 2-week sandbox with SSO, sample load up to 200 concurrent sessions, and basic quality checks against 5 representative prompts.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive + sandbox demo (45–60 minutes) — propose Thu 17 Sep at 9:30am PT or Fri 18 Sep at 11:00am PT. Please confirm which works and we’ll send a calendar invite.
2) Loop in procurement & security — you mentioned a procurement lead and security owner; can you share the right contacts?
3) I’m attaching a short discovery notes PDF and a one-page pilot plan for your review.

Attachments: redwood_discovery_notes.pdf, redwood_pilot_scope.md

If those slots don't work, send 2 alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nsh@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124
